description: The chart consists of three pie charts, each representing different levels of difficulty: easy, medium, and hard. The easy pie chart has four slices with the following proportions: 55.4% for N+K+, 38.3% for N-K+, 4.6% for N-K-, and 1.7% for N+K-. The medium pie chart also has four slices with the following proportions: 58.8% for N+K+, 35.4% for N-K+, 4.0% for N-K-, and 1.8% for N+K-. The hard pie chart has four slices with the following proportions: 37.3% for N+K+, 37.9% for N-K+, 18.1% for N-K-, and 6.7% for N+K-. Each pie chart includes a legend with color coding for the categories: N+K+ (green), N-K+ (yellow), N-K- (orange), and N+K- (red). The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and there are no percentage labels inside the slices. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest slice at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
